## Incident Overview
CI Script Tests fail on PR #243 because consult-recipe-registry.sh line 26 uses a relative path `$SCRIPT_DIR/../recipes/recipe-registry.yaml` instead of resolving via `_PLUGIN_ROOT` / `CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT`.

**code_version:** 5073d4fecfbd7754b1c8e140473c4e4ce65d0f70
**Failing test:** test_no_relative_paths_in_plugin_scripts
**Affected file:** plugins/dso/scripts/consult-recipe-registry.sh:26
data.title: [consult-recipe-registry.sh]: relative path in REGISTRY default -> test_no_relative_paths_in_plugin_scripts fails
